ic_name: NFC / ISO 14443 (NXP AN10833 MIFARE family — subset)
test_cases_present: partial - AN10833 plus ISO/IEC 14443-1/2/3/4 define functional commands, register layouts, anti-collision flow, and timing tables that map directly to compliance test scenarios. ISO 10373-6 is the normative compliance test framework and is out of scope of this application note.
derived_compliance_test_categories: Reset behavior: enable bit cleared; transmit-empty flag set; receive-flag cleared after reset.
Master mode transmission: write to data register + clock-cycle delay + N edges + receive-flag set.
Slave mode transmission: select line goes LOW + N edges from master + receive-flag set after last edge.
